'''2007 Dagobah Regionals Ben Scott DS No Money, No Parts, No Deal!''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Ben Scott]] at [[2007 Dagobah Regionals]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|No Money, No Parts, No Deal! / You're A Slave?|Cor-D-nomoneynopartsnodeal.gif}}
* '''Deck name:''' Watto
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
